Callout.Name: Prisoner Escape
Callout.Message: Prisoner has escaped from custody during transport.
Callout.Advisory: Suspect on foot in cuffs, last seen crossing the road.

Script.Line: He is still in cuffs. Cuffed in the front.
He crossed the road and went down towards the river.
I am not chasing him on my own across that ground.

Lines.Approach: He is still in cuffs and he is on foot. He cannot have gone far.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
